messages:
maria: FYI our JS SDK packaging change is causing installs to fail on Bun and Deno for the sample-app. node esm works but other runtimes choke.

maria: bun error when running `bun install`: 
```
Error: Could not resolve package entry "./dist/index.cjs" from 'redwood'
```
josh: which package.json fields did we change? exports/main/module?
maria: we added a conditional exports map to prefer ESM: 
```json
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "import": "./dist/index.mjs",
    "require": "./dist/index.cjs"
  },
  "./package.json": "./package.json"
}
```
sam: Bun and Deno don't exactly follow Node's conditional exports. Bun sometimes ignores conditions if `type` is `module`. Deno doesn't use Node resolution at all.
maria: sample-app just does `import Redwood from 'redwood'` and bun reports module not found. Node resolves the mjs entry fine.
kat: what's top-level `type` in package.json?
maria: we changed to `type: "module"` (ESM-first) but left cjs builds for consumers.
josh: short-term hack: add a `main` and `module` field and a non-conditional `default` export fallback so non-Node resolvers can still find something. bun historically falls back to `main` in some versions.
sam: typings are impacted too. tsc can't find our `index.d.ts` because `exports` hides it; `types` field helps but some tools still look at exports.
maria: I tried adding `main`, `module`, and `types` pointing at `./dist/index.cjs`, `./dist/index.mjs`, and `./dist/types/index.d.ts`. bun install now succeeds, but deno still rejects the package.
kat: for Deno we probably need a separate Deno bundle or docs recommending `import` from a CDN or Git URL. can't solve Deno via Node exports alone.
josh: another approach: emit small top-level entry files like `redwood.cjs.js` and `redwood.mjs.js` that re-export compiled code. Resolvers that don't understand `exports` can still import those files directly.
maria: will add that to the packaging script and update sample-app to point at the explicit file when running on Bun in its README.
build-bot: CI matrix: node v18/v20 passed, bun v1.2.0 failed bundler test.
sam: add a lightweight onboarding e2e test: install sample-app with Bun and Deno import-check to catch regressions early.
josh: opening infra ticket and will propose package layout changes.
maria: created tracker: https://linear.app/RW/issue/RW-4579-package-entries-bun-deno-interop with reproducer and steps. tagging @josh @sam.
kat: after fix, bump sample-app dep and add CI smoke job: `bun install && bun run start`.
maria: thanks. packaging feels easy until it isn't :facepalm:
